item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 Beta 1

The first beta of Tailwing for Mac. Tailwing takes notes on your calls and writes them up on this Mac.

Your notes, recordings and models move to a new folder the first time this version opens. Nothing is copied or uploaded, and nothing changes in the app.

Send Feedback, in the menu bar menu and in Help, writes us an email with your versions filled in.
